title: Origins: Fellmouth Demon
description: An origin that spawns in the Nether, using its ability to generate steam to dash and fight.
body:
# 😈 Fellmouth Demon
### [ Impact 2 ]
A wanderer from a distant kingdom, this demon seeks to witness all that the world has to offer.

> An origin created for an OC of mine! This is filled with advancements, with more to come and has some nice VFX and combat!

## Powerlist

<details>
<summary>Steamheart</summary>

A little resource above the hunger that fills up on its own over time.

When sneaking, this fills up faster, and it can't fill up when you're in water or gliding.
This resource naturally depletes while you are submerged in water, unless you are wearing a full set of Water Protection.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Fellmouth's Dance</summary>

Unleash pressurized steam to dash or climb surfaces.
- You can also walljump.

A dash that cuts through your opponent, igniting them with Fellfire upon contact.
- Dashing grants you Invincibility for 0.5s.
- Affected entities emit a constant glow and trail of smoke, suffer a 50% reduction in armor, and move 20% slower.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hearts of Flame</summary>

Your attacks deal fire damage, but it doesn’t linger. While you’re on fire, your next attack is empowered, extinguishing the flames afterward.
- Right-click with a flint and steel to ignite yourself. Works whether held in your main or off hand.

Awakened by a sudden shift in temperature, you realize you are no longer in your kingdom. Memories of your mission return. Your adventure beginning in the Crimson Forest.

</details>

<details>
<summary>At What Cost?</summary>

You are unaffected by the slowing effects of soul sand. When equipped with Soul Speed, your pace increases dramatically, letting you sprint across with ease.

However, traversing soul sand or soul soil gradually drains your steam reserves.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Blameworthy</summary>

Because Fellmouth has long harvested the Nether’s inhabitants for resources, its name is cursed throughout the realm. As a result, nearly every native creature regards you as an enemy, regardless of any gold you wear.

Even overworld villagers recoil at your presence, refusing all trade. Iron golems will attack on sight, driven by instinctive fury.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Instability</summary>

Because of your intense heat, ice and snow dampen your steam. You take increased damage from freezing.

Snowballs inflict bonus damage and reduce your steam when they hit.
- -20 Steam per hit.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Staggering Blow</summary>

Constantly dodging attacks and relying on your Fellfire Guard has weakened your defense. When below half health, you take increased damage.
- Dropping below 50% Health increases damage taken by 50%

</details>

<details>
<summary>Wicked</summary>

Your demonic nature makes you more vulnerable to Smite, and you tire quicker than that of mortals.
- Exhaustion increased by 87.5%

</details>

## Dependencies
This datapack does require the [Origins Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins).
